about: One grammar for the words beside a price, proven twice: tests/test_one_quote_words.py asserts market_data.one_quote.words and SVVenue.words (static/js/sv-venue.js) on every case. Synthetic payloads. Hand-written expectations: the build spec's table (one price everywhere, 1.6). The fields section (2026-11-12, the review's fixes) pins the other cells a price carries: its age and clock face (a shut market and a previous close said so), the move since entry, the distance to a level, reward to risk now, and the hover; market_data.one_quote.field_words and SVVenue.fieldText. eToro's all-week instruments (2026-11-19, market_data/all_week_display.py): an open price while Sauron's own clock is shut leads with "open · eToro 24/7" until that clock reopens (wk.open, wk.until), one of eToro's breaks reads "pause" with its reopening (shut.word), and the next break an open price carries turns it to a pause by itself (wk.np).
